title: Story premise ENT047: The Dandelion Launch Network
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (block-world chain reactions). Hook: The first seed has to start the next journey. Takeaway/theme: A chain can distribute outputs instead of piling them at its start.
description: A block gardener wants to scatter square fantasy seeds across an empty grid, but one launcher keeps dropping them in a pile. Landing seeds depress miniature release platforms for preloaded launchers farther away, spreading a bounded zigzag trail until the final seed raises a miniature garden sign.
